prior_failures_remain_true: The default ss netlink read was denied; its exit0 is not a reliable port result. The single approved escalated invocation failed in its environment wrapper before obtaining ss output.
adjustment_reason: Static review established that pg_ctl -w start for the fixed new data path precedes every SQL connection. PostgreSQL uses OS binding on the exact 127.0.0.1:55432 endpoint, with no Unix socket fallback. A conflicting binding causes startup failure, followed only by owned-data cleanup or stop-only recovery; no pre-failure SQL connection to another instance occurs.
not_a_bypass: No ss retry, alternate port probe, alternate port, sandbox escalation, network/security change, foreign-service action, or old-data restart was performed. This separate already-authorized startup used the unchanged reviewed source under the default sandbox.
residual_risk_disclosed: No absolute guarantee against extreme successful-start-then-process/socket replacement TOCTOU; the independent ss precheck would not eliminate that lifecycle race.
not_claimed: No netlink read success, no previous preflight repair, no new write-authorization acceptance result
decision_scope: Only the additional independent ss precheck was withdrawn after static review; this did not retry the denied netlink read or claim that its environment issue was fixed. Ordinary authorized PG startup was separately attempted once.
